content: Radio Browser guidelines: resolve all.api.radio-browser.info (or /json/servers), randomize and fail over; descriptive User-Agent; use stationuuid, countrycode, url_resolved; call /json/url/{uuid} on play (counted once/day/IP/station); hidebroken default false. Live BG snapshot 2026-09-24: 344 stations, 35 lastcheckok=0, 173 http url_resolved, 83 IP-literal hosts, 57 duplicate names, 160 without favicon, aggregator distribution tags; BNR Horizont entries point to play.global.audio.
